title: dupatya trichophylla
intro: Dupatya trichophylla, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chinese angelica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases.
